name: KOS International Talent Group Limited
summary: KOS International Talent Group Limited, founded in 2009 and based in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong, is an investment holding company providing human resources services in Hong Kong, Macau, China and Singapore. It offers recruitment, secondment and payroll under brands including KOS Executive, KOS Recruitment and KOS Staffing. It was previously KOS International Holdings Limited, a subsidiary of KJE Limited, and changed its name in February 2026.
